params.description: Select tasks with the given category. Note that this is the task category, not the category of the process definition (namespace within the BPMN Xml).

params.name: taskWithoutCategory

params.name: finished
params.description: Indication if the historic task instance is finished.

params.description: Indication if the process instance of the historic task instance is finished.

params.name: dueDate
params.description: Return only historic task instances that have a due date equal this date.

params.name: dueDateAfter
params.description: Return only historic task instances that have a due date after this date.

params.name: dueDateBefore
params.description: Return only historic task instances that have a due date before this date.

params.name: withoutDueDate
params.description: Return only historic task instances that have no due-date. When false is provided as value, this parameter is ignored.

params.name: scopeType

params.description: Property to sort on, to be used together with the order.

params.name: order
params.description: The sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'. Defaults to 'asc'.

params.description: Index of the first row to fetch. Defaults to 0.

params.name: size
params.description: Number of rows to fetch, starting from start. Defaults to 10.

items.docs: All supported JSON parameter fields allowed are exactly the same as the parameters found for getting a collection of historic task instances, but passed in as JSON-body arguments rather than URL-parameters to allow for more advanced querying and preventing errors with request-uri’s that are too long. On top of that, the query allows for filtering based on process variables. The taskVariables and processVariables properties are JSON-arrays containing objects with the format as described here.
